_comment: Pause-guard inventory (#1042). Every method exported by the contract must appear in exactly one list. scripts/check-pause-guard-inventory.ts fails, naming the method, when one is missing or stale.

exempt.initialize: bootstrap: runs before any pause can exist
exempt.migrate: recovery: schema migration must stay possible while paused
exempt.set_operator: governance: role changes must stay possible while paused
exempt.revoke_operator: governance: role changes must stay possible while paused
exempt.renounce_operator: governance: an operator can always step down
exempt.propose_admin: governance: admin rotation must stay possible while paused
exempt.accept_admin: governance: admin rotation must stay possible while paused
exempt.cancel_admin_proposal: governance: admin rotation must stay possible while paused
exempt.get_pending_admin: read that drops an expired proposal as a side effect
exempt.get_pending_operator: read that drops an expired proposal as a side effect
exempt.propose_operator: governance: role changes must stay possible while paused
exempt.accept_operator: governance: role changes must stay possible while paused
exempt.cancel_operator_proposal: governance: role changes must stay possible while paused
exempt.renounce_admin: governance: an admin can always step down
exempt.pause: pause control: must work in any state
exempt.unpause: pause control: the only way out of a pause
exempt.set_config: maintenance: config fixes may be needed during an incident
exempt.import_config_map: maintenance: config fixes may be needed during an incident
exempt.reset_config_to_defaults: maintenance: config fixes may be needed during an incident
exempt.set_max_outage_duration: maintenance: config fixes may be needed during an incident
exempt.set_migration_key: recovery: emergency migration path must stay possible while paused
exempt.execute_migration: recovery: emergency migration path must stay possible while paused
